'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]

***A [[war correspondent]] for the [[Russia]]n newspaper ''[[Izvestia]]'' is killed in a [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[drone warfare|drone strike]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. *[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]], [[Guatemala–Haiti relations]]
**[[Gang war in Haiti]]
***Another 75 [[Armed Forces of Guatemala|Guatemalan Army]] troops arrive in [[Haiti]], joining 75 that arrived yesterday, to combat escalating gang violence. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/03/americas/haiti-gang-violence-guatemala-el-salvador-soldiers-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2ld49lqq5qo (BBC News)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least 70 [[Palestinians]] are killed and 14 others are reported missing in [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] airstrikes on [[Gaza City]] and [[Khan Yunis|Khan Younis]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. *[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
***[[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] capture the strategic town of Katale in [[Masisi Territory]], [[North Kivu Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://chimpreports.com/drc-m23-rebels-capture-strategic-town-of-katale-in-masisi-territory/ (Chimp Reports)]
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**Gunmen from [[Nigeria]] kill at least five [[Army of Cameroon|Cameroonian soldiers]] and injure several others in Bakinjaw, [[Southwest Region (Cameroon)|Southwest Region]], [[Cameroon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-nigeria-kill-five-cameroonian-soldiers-mp-says-2025-01-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**One person is killed and 35 others are injured, including [[Pakistan Armed Forces|soldiers]], in a [[car bomb]]ing in [[Turbat]], [[Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. The [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] claims responsibility for the attack, which states it targeted a military convoy. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-balochistan-turbat-explosion-soldiers-72c4df692f4f0950d882d1b3961c32f2 (AP)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**The [[Nigerian Army]] repels an ambush in [[Borno State]] and kills 34 Islamist militants in a gun battle in which six soldiers also die. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerian-troops-repel-boko-haram-ambush-borno-kill-34-insurgents-2025-01-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[January 2025 North American storm complex]]
**[[Governor of Kentucky|Kentucky Governor]] [[Andy Beshear]] declares a [[state of emergency]] for [[Kentucky]], [[United States]], amidst the upcoming winter storm. [https://www.wnky.com/release-gov-beshear-declares-state-of-emergency-ahead-of-winter-storm-system/ (WNKY)]
*At least eight people are killed and 15 others are injured in a fire at a market in [[Zhangjiakou]], [[Hebei]], [[China]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/4/fire-at-market-in-hebei-china-kills-and-wounds-several-people (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[Coast Guard Administration (Taiwan)|Taiwanese Coast Guard]] intercepts the [[Cameroon]]-registered [[container ship]] ''Shunxin39'' after it was suspected of damaging an undersea cable north of [[Taiwan]] yesterday. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/ (Taiwan News)]
*A fishing boat ran aground near [[Gageodo]], [[South Korea]] after colliding with coastal rocks. Three people were killed, 19 were rescued. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2550531 (NOS)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Myanmar]] [[Media in Myanmar|state media]] reports that the [[State Administration Council|ruling military junta]] will release 5,864 prisoners, including 180 foreigners, under an amnesty marking the country's [[Independence Day (Myanmar)|national independence day]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-junta-free-5864-prisoners-under-amnesty-2025-01-04/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Denmark|Danish]] [[Danish Security and Intelligence Service|Security and Intelligence Service]] and [[Police of Denmark|police]] announce an investigation into sightings of unknown [[unidentified flying object|drones]] reportedly flying over [[Køge]], [[Region Zealand]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/danish-police-investigate-mystery-drone-sightings/a-71217317 (DW)]
*Four teenagers are arrested in [[Yekaterinburg]], [[Russia]], for allegedly planning a [[terrorism|terrorist]] attack in the city. Two of the suspects are also accused of being involved in an [[arson attack]] on a [[Ministry of Internal Affairs (Russia)|Ministry of Internal Affairs]] vehicle in December. [https://www.dw.com/en/russia-four-arrested-for-plotting-terrorist-attack/a-71216812 (DW)]
